entry.description: stop `AdoNetAppender` from retrying a whole batch one event at a time when none of them can be written. Retrying after a rolled back transaction was added in 3.4.0 to save the events around the one the database rejected, but a batch that fails outright, such as a missing table or a missing permission, then cost one round trip per event: 513 instead of 1 for a full buffer. It now gives up after five consecutive failures (implemented by @FreeAndNil)
